This is the first special chapter of the [[I Can't Choose, Eevee]] manga. It was first published on [[Poké Times]] on January 21, 2025 at 8:00 PM JST.<ref>[https://twitter.com/poke_times/status/1881658015243288917 Special chapter 1 on Poké Times] (Japanese)</ref> It is 8 pages long.

This is one of three possible endings to the manga. It would've been the final chapter if the [[EYE03|third chapter]] had garnered more reposts than the [[EYE02|second]] and [[EYE04|fourth]] chapters.
